items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: Ed O. Emma Thomas, when she was singing with the Contra, and every way he went, he made a hit with it.

ctx.x: We only got a few more minutes if you can make it. I'll make it. Looks like about seven, five minutes, something like that. You mentioned something about Al Hurd. How did that work?

That was nice, man. I enjoyed winning Chucks with him. He was all right, man. He's a pretty good fella, too. It was really something that I enjoyed. When we were going on the road with him, he would come on stage with his group. Then after they grew, then we would come on with a small band, a seven-piece band. Then after we get off the stage, then Contra would come on with a small seven-piece band.
